meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求时，Claude 会检查本机的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装，与最新源码比对，并输出一份每项判定都附有命令输出或文件证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 健康报告。它只做诊断，不会改动你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当你说要“医生”或“健康检查”，提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等关键词，或怀疑安装/更新/配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 做个体检，看看安装健不健康。
say.note: 会输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告。

say.text: 对比一下本地 Codex 和最新源码，有没有过时。
say.note: 会检查版本漂移和配置是否匹配最新安装器。

say.text: 刚更新完 Codex 就怪怪的，帮我诊断下。
say.note: 会检查插件负载、配置和运行时探针。

howto.what_en: After installation, when asked, Claude audits the local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install against the latest sources and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where every verdict cites a command output or file. It only diagnoses; it never mutates the user's install, config, or repositories.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a doctor/health check, mentions LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or suspects Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a health check on my LazyCodex install.
Compare my local Codex against the latest source for drift.
say_en.note: Checks versions, config, and payload wiring.

say_en.text: Codex started acting oddly after an update; diagnose it.
say_en.note: Probes the runtime and checks known issues.
